title: Silent operator config override: max_command_size clamp has no warning log
description: mod.rs lines 155-160 clamp options.max_command_size upward to max_literal_size + 1 when the operator has configured max_command_size_bytes below max_literal_bytes. The comment explains the library invariant but the code silently overrides the operator's configured value with no log warning. An operator who sets max_command_size_bytes=4096 and max_literal_bytes=8192 in config will silently get max_command_size=8193 instead of 4096 with no indication this happened. Low severity (the override is safe and keeps the server running) but a maintainer diagnosing unexpected behaviour will not find the discrepancy from logs alone. Fix: add a tracing::warn\! when the clamp fires, naming both the configured value and the effective value used.
